# Test DOWN to see full vertical range, then try to reach the charcoal/magenta area
# First go DOWN
result = action(['DOWN'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation

def find_node(seg, color):
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == color:
            rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols), n['pixels'])
    return None

print("After DOWN:")

print("Blue bar:", find_node(seg, 'b'))
print("Charcoal:", find_node(seg, 'c'))
print("Magenta:", find_node(seg, 'M'))

# Check adjacency
adj = seg['adjacency_list']
# Find blue bar node id
blue_id = None
for i, n in enumerate(seg['nodes']):
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        blue_id = i
        break
print("\nBlue bar adjacency:", [pair for pair in adj if blue_id in pair])
</parameter>
